notes: SHUKET reports exclusion limits on hidden photon kinetic mixing χ in the mass range 20.8 µeV to 28.3 µeV (corresponding to 5–6.8 GHz frequency range). The paper states: 'the upper limit on χ is of the order of 5×10−12 for HP masses between 20.8 µeV and 28.3 µeV' at 95% C.L. This is a mass-independent (flat) bound across the stated range. The local DM density assumption ρ = 0.3 GeV/cm³ is explicitly used in Eq. 2 and the interpretation section. The experiment assumes hidden photons constitute all of the dark matter and uses the misalignment mechanism production scenario. Figure 5 shows the red exclusion curve; the narrow-band search at 6.331525 GHz yields a slightly improved limit of χ ≈ 4.2×10−12 (derived from the 2.1×10−21 W upper limit via Eq. 2). The coupling type is DarkPhoton because the paper explicitly discusses kinetic mixing χ between hidden photons and conventional photons. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.92, 2))
